mapper.select: SELECT permission_code FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_permission WHERE custom_role_id = #{customRoleId} ORDER BY permission_code

SELECT membership.membership_id, membership.tenant_id, membership.subject_id, membership.membership_role, membership.status, membership.permission_version, membership.version, membership.created_at FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.custom_role_id = #{customRoleId} AND membership.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY membership.membership_id FOR UPDATE OF membership

SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.membership_permission direct_permission WHERE direct_permission.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND direct_permission.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND direct_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding built_in_binding WHERE built_in_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND built_in_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND built_in_binding.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_custom_role_binding custom_binding INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role custom_role ON custom_role.tenant_id = custom_binding.tenant_id AND custom_role.custom_role_id = custom_binding.custom_role_id AND custom_role.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN organization_access.tenant_custom_role_permission custom_permission ON custom_permission.custom_role_id = custom_role.custom_role_id AND custom_permission.permission_code = 'access:manage' WHERE custom_binding.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND custom_binding.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND (#{retainsAccessManage} = TRUE OR custom_binding.custom_role_id <> #{customRoleId}) )
